rawMatchedLines.text: Use a versioned authenticated-encryption envelope and vetted platform cryptography; no custom cipher. Proposed implementation contract: AES-256-GCM with a fresh random salt and nonce per package, scrypt-derived key, explicit bounded KDF parameters, authenticated format/schema metadata, and test vectors. Independent security review must validate nonce/key handling and password input before acceptance. The passphrase is masked in a local interactive prompt; never a command-line argument, environment variable, chat message, file tracked in Git, diagnostic, command receipt or log. Passphrase custody is separate from the package; no key escrow or recovery promise if it is lost.

rawMatchedLines.text: Binary envelope: 8-byte magic `VHQREC01`, 4-byte unsigned big-endian header length, canonical UTF-8 JSON header (maximum 1024 bytes), ciphertext, 16-byte GCM tag. Fixed header keys: format=1, cipher=`aes-256-gcm`, kdf=`scrypt`, N=32768, r=8, p=1, salt=16 random bytes base64, nonce=12 random bytes base64, plaintextBytes. The whole prefix including magic/header length/header is authenticated additional data. Scrypt uses 64 MiB maxmem, a 32-byte key and a 12–256-byte UTF-8 passphrase. Fresh salt and nonce per package. Authenticated decryption completes before JSON interpretation, schema rebuilding or extraction. The finite fixed KDF is deliberately not attacker-configurable. No archive compression or arbitrary members.
